correctness.rationale: Joint concavity of root Uhlmann fidelity reduces minimization over shared diagonal preparations to a localized vertex. For fixed vertex j, expanded classical e^(-tL) and dephasing double commutator: sigma_jj=1-s1*t+O(t²), rho_jj=1-gamma*s2*t+O(t²), neighbor Q-block of sqrt(sigma)*rho*sqrt(sigma) has leading rank-one gamma*t² v v^T with v_k=w_jk^(3/2). The separated eigenvalues give D_j(t)=[s1+gamma*s2-2sqrt(gamma*s3)]t+o(t). For unweighted d>=1, derivative of c_gamma(d)=(1+gamma)d-2sqrt(gamma*d) is >0. As t→∞ with gamma>0, quantum pinches into Laplacian eigenspaces and classical tends to I/N. Exact K_(a,b) vertex projection masses are 1/N, b/(aN),(a-1)/a, giving terminal D_a=1-[1/sqrt(N)+sqrt(b/(aN))+sqrt((a-1)/a)]²/N. T_N(a) is strictly decreasing for a>=2; hence for 2<=m<n early optimum m-part and late optimum n-part. Continuity forces finite crossover; star maximum and balanced minimum follow the same terminal comparison. Fresh standalone matrix pinching checks across six graph pairs and nine gamma cases corroborated formulas, not unique transition or arbitrary graphs.
